units.source_text: 鹤川让东京的家不时寄些甜食来。

en.t: Tsurukawa sometimes had sweets sent from his home in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 夜深人静时，他悄悄地来到我的枕边，我们一起吃了。

en.t: Late at night, when everyone was asleep and the house was quiet, he would quietly come to my bedside, and we would eat them together.

units.source_text: 深夜，天空时不时地划出几道闪电。

en.t: Deep in the night, streaks of lightning would flash across the sky from time to time.
